captions.detailed: This 3D model features a fence-clamp camera bracket mounted on a long, grey rectangular rail. The black bracket assembly includes a C-clamp base that slides linearly along the rail, an adjustable articulating arm with multiple pivot joints, and a small, semi-transparent dome camera head at the end. The assembly allows for sliding adjustment along the rail, panning at the arm joints, and pan-tilt rotation of the camera head.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for an articulated fence-clamp camera bracket. The model should include a grey rectangular rail, a sliding black C-clamp base, an articulating arm with pivot joints, and a dome-shaped camera head capable of pan and tilt rotation.
captions.factory: The script uses CadQuery primitives to construct the assembly. It models the rail as a long Box, and the sliding clamp base using a combination of subtracted Box shapes to form the C-clamp. The articulating arm is built by chaining cylindrical and rectangular segments, while the camera head is created using a cylinder and a sphere. These components are organized into an ArticulatedObject with prismatic, revolute, and fixed joints to define the system's degrees of freedom.
